## Diet Seurat
```{r}
# subset out rare samples: 1959-PDA_OLGC; 2185-clear cell carcinoma; 1971-Acinar cell carcinoma, 2153-Acinar cell carcinoma
sts.malignant <- sts.simspec.sct %>% subset(subset = Patient_ID %in% c("1959","2185","1971","2153"), invert=T)

# subset out the malignant
sts.malignant <- sts.malignant %>% subset(subset = simspec_cell_class == "PDAC") #26788 x 53440 # this is the value after filtering out rare malignancies

# subset out "PDAC" that didn't show changes in CNV from inferCNV analysis
sts.malignant <- sts.malignant %>% subset(subset = Cell_Ids %in% non.malig, invert=T) # confirmed removal of unwanted cells 26788 x 53356

# DietSeurat
dim(sts.malignant) #  26788 x 53356
DefaultAssay(sts.malignant) <- "RNA"
sts.malignant <- Seurat::DietSeurat(sts.malignant, assays = "RNA", data = TRUE, counts = TRUE)
colnames(sts.malignant[[]]) #check which columns to remove
sts.malignant[["nCount_SCT"]] <- NULL
sts.malignant[["nFeature_SCT"]] <- NULL
sts.malignant[["seurat_clusters"]] <- NULL
sts.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.0.8"]] <- NULL
sts.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.0.9"]] <- NULL
sts.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.1"]] <- NULL
sts.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.1.1"]] <- NULL
sts.malignant[["SCT_snn_res.1.2"]] <- NULL
```

## Normalised by SCTransform on individual sample
```{r}
sts.malignant <- SplitObject(sts.malignant, split.by = "Sample")

# Ref: codes shared by Fernando
for (i in names(sts.malignant)){
  sts.malignant[[i]] <- SCTransform(sts.malignant[[i]],
    vst.flavor = "v2",
    method = "glmGamPoi",
    verbose = TRUE,
    #vars.to.regress = c("subsets_mito_percent"),
    #ncells = ncol(sts.malignant[[i]])
    )
}
```

## Simspec integration 
```{r}
# Merge and set common features 
int.features.split <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = sts.malignant, nfeatures = 2000)
sts.malignant.simspec <- merge(x = sts.malignant[[1]], y = sts.malignant[2:length(sts.malignant)], 
                         merge.data = TRUE)
VariableFeatures(sts.malignant.simspec) <- int.features.split

# PCA 
sts.malignant.simspec <- RunPCA(sts.malignant.simspec, verbose = TRUE, assay = "SCT",
                                  npcs = 30) #default npcs = 50

# Run CSS ----
#install.packages("devtools")
#devtools::install_github("quadbiolab/simspec")
library(simspec)

# On running simspec_CSS on SCTranformed objects https://github.com/immunogenomics/simspec_CSS/issues/41
sts.malignant.simspec <-
  simspec::cluster_sim_spectrum(
    object = sts.malignant.simspec,
    label_tag = "orig.ident", #original sample labels from pre-processing step
    cluster_resolution = 0.4,
    corr_method = "pearson",
    spectrum_type = "corr_kernel"
  )

cat("Current reductions in object:", Reductions(sts.malignant.simspec)) # pca css
# Current reductions in object: pca css

# Reference codes from:  https://doi.org/10.17632/3kthhpw2pd 
sts.malignant.simspec <- RunUMAP(sts.malignant.simspec, reduction = "css", 
                                   dims = 1:ncol(Embeddings(sts.malignant.simspec, "css")), #294
                                   reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_")

sts.malignant.simspec <- FindNeighbors(sts.malignant.simspec, reduction="css", 
                                         dims = 1:ncol(Embeddings(sts.malignant.simspec, "css")))

sts.malignant.simspec <- FindClusters(sts.malignant.simspec, algorithm = 3, resolution = 0.1)
```

## Malignant clusters from the deposited object
The pseudobulk analysis below uses the 6 malignant clusters at resolution 0.1. Cluster numbers can change between environments, so the clusters are read from the deposited object (`stage3_malignant_SCT_snn_res.0.1`, the original clusters), matched by cell ID. The rerun clusters are compared with them here.

```{r malignant-clusters, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, results='asis'}
deposited_clusters <- deposited_labels(sts.malignant.simspec, "stage3_malignant_SCT_snn_res.0.1")
rerun_clusters <- as.character(sts.malignant.simspec$SCT_snn_res.0.1)

print(knitr::kable(compare_clusters(rerun_clusters, deposited_clusters,
                                    "Malignant: rerun clusters (res 0.1) vs original clusters", params$step_dir),
                   row.names = FALSE))
print(knitr::kable(compare_labels(rerun_clusters, deposited_clusters,
                                  "Malignant: rerun cluster numbers vs original cluster numbers", params$step_dir),
                   row.names = FALSE))

sts.malignant.simspec$rerun_SCT_snn_res.0.1 <- rerun_clusters
sts.malignant.simspec$SCT_snn_res.0.1 <- factor(deposited_clusters, levels = sort(unique(as.numeric(deposited_clusters))))
```

## DE analysis to define malignant programs (MPs) - Pseudobulk using edgeR
```{r}
#Ref: https://github.com/yunshun/HumanBreast10X/blob/main/RCode/NormTotal.R
DefaultAssay(sts.malignant.simspec) <- "RNA"

MP <- sts.malignant.simspec
MP$seurat_clusters <- NULL
MP$seurat_clusters <- MP$SCT_snn_res.0.1   # the original clusters, from the deposited object (chunk malignant-clusters)
MP$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(as.numeric(as.character(MP$seurat_clusters)) + 1)
ClusterSub <- as.factor(MP@meta.data$seurat_clusters) #number of clusters
PatClust <- paste(MP$Patient_ID, ClusterSub, sep = "_Clst") #labelling each cell with Sample#_Cls#

# Pseudobulk samples by aggregrating read counts for each genes per cluster-patient
raw.counts <- as.matrix(MP@assays$RNA@counts)#dgCMatrix
counts <- t(rowsum(t(raw.counts), group=PatClust))

library(limma)
library(edgeR)
count.matrix <- DGEList(counts) 
count.matrix$samples$Patient <- gsub("_Clst.*$","", colnames(count.matrix)) #adding a new column, named Patient 
count.matrix$samples$Cluster <- as.numeric(gsub("^.*_Clst","",colnames(count.matrix))) #adding a new column, named Cluster
count.matrix$samples$group <- count.matrix$samples$Cluster
count.matrix #count matrix

ncls <- length(table(ClusterSub))
stopifnot(ncls == 6)   # the contrasts below are written for the 6 clusters at resolution 0.1
N <- 1:ncls #focus on all clusters
ClstSub <- count.matrix[,count.matrix$samples$Cluster %in% N] 
keep <- filterByExpr(ClstSub, min.count=5, min.total.count=10) #min=10, min.total.count=20
ClstSub <- ClstSub[keep, , keep=F]
ClstSub <- calcNormFactors(ClstSub) # to calculate normalisation factors to a algin columns of a count matrix
ClstSub$samples$group

pat.col <- c("#6DE8B7","#D741E1","#B4E1CF","#DEB8E0","#DD4A8C","#7F9F32","#C3EAB4" ,"#7B67E0" ,"#D8E746" ,"#CEE982" ,"#DE73DA" ,"#92A36F" ,"#67C0D8" ,"#E1A497" ,"#E76356" ,"#62A4DB", "#D79655" ,"#8966AA", "#9899E8" ,"#6EE9E7","#E4C751" ,"#E7E3DA" ) 
plotMDS(ClstSub, pch = 16, col = pat.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="")

#Design matrix
Cls <- as.factor(ClstSub$samples$Cluster)
Pat <- factor(ClstSub$samples$Patient)
design <- model.matrix(~ Cls + Pat)

#Estimate NB dispersion & QL dispersion
ClstSub <- estimateDisp(ClstSub, design = design)
qfit <- glmQLFit(ClstSub, design)

contr <- makeContrasts(
    Cls1 = -(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4+Cls5+Cls6)/5, 
    Cls2 = Cls2-(Cls3+Cls4+Cls5+Cls6)/5, 
    Cls3 = Cls3-(Cls2+Cls4+Cls5+Cls6)/5, 
    Cls4 = Cls4-(Cls2+Cls3+Cls5+Cls6)/5, 
    Cls5 = Cls5-(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4+Cls6)/5, 
    Cls6 = Cls6-(Cls2+Cls3+Cls4+Cls5)/5, 
    levels=design)

de.test <- list()
for (i in 1:ncls) de.test[[i]] <- glmQLFTest(qfit, contrast = contr[,i])

#log-CPM
prior.count <- 1
ClstSub.cpm <- edgeR::cpm(ClstSub, log=T, prior.count=prior.count) #calculating cpm

# Remove batch effect on log-CPM
logCPM_no_batch <- removeBatchEffect(ClstSub.cpm, batch=Pat, group = Cls) # for visualisation purposes only
boxplot(as.data.frame(ClstSub.cpm),main="Original")
boxplot(as.data.frame(logCPM_no_batch),main="Batch corrected")
plotMDS(logCPM_no_batch, pch = 16, col = pat.col[ClstSub$samples$group], main="Pseudo-bulk samples")

### Extract top significant genes
library(tibble)
names(de.test) <- colnames(contr)   # label each result by its contrast

res_list <- lapply(names(de.test), function(cn) {
  topTags(de.test[[cn]], n = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")$table %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(cluster = cn)
})

names(res_list) <- names(de.test)
res_all <- bind_rows(res_list)   # one compiled table
MP.pseudobulk <- res_all
```

### ORA
```{r}
# Ref codes modified from Fer's
library("msigdbr")
library("clusterProfiler")
library("org.Hs.eg.db")
Hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
Hallmark.entrez <- dplyr::select(Hallmark, gs_name, entrez_gene)

gene.symbols <- MP.pseudobulk$gene %>% unique()
gene.entrez <- bitr(gene.symbols, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", drop = F)
colnames(gene.entrez)[1] <- "gene"
markers.ann <- left_join(MP.pseudobulk, gene.entrez, by = "gene")

dgea.ls <- split(markers.ann, f=markers.ann$cluster)

#focus on all up-regulated genes
dgea.up.filtered <- purrr::map(dgea.ls, ~ dplyr::filter(., logFC > 1 & FDR < 0.05,!is.na(ENTREZID)))
dgea.ls.up.entrez.id <- purrr::map(dgea.up.filtered, ~ dplyr::pull(., ENTREZID))

universe <- bitr(gene.symbols,
                 fromType = "SYMBOL",
                 toType = "ENTREZID",
                 OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
```

```{r ext-data-fig-1c, fig.width=10, fig.height=10, dpi=300, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Extended Data Fig 1C
hallmark <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = dgea.ls.up.entrez.id,
  fun = "enricher",
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  universe = universe$ENTREZID,
  TERM2GENE = Hallmark.entrez)
dotplot(hallmark, font.size = 12, showCategory = 5, title = "Hallmark | pseudobulk RNA assay|edgeR | logFC > 1")  + RotatedAxis() + scale_colour_gradient(low="coral3", high = "steelblue")
```

## Standard processing - normalise, dimentionality reduction, clustering
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
# SCTRANFORM
rare <- SCTransform(rare, vst.flavor = "v2", method = "glmGamPoi", verbose = TRUE)

# DIMENTIONALITY REDUCTION
rare <- RunPCA(rare, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE, assay = "SCT")
ElbowPlot(rare)

DimPlot(rare, label = TRUE,
        reduction = "pca", group.by = "Patient_ID") + NoLegend()

rare <- RunUMAP(rare, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)

# CLUSTERING
rare <- FindNeighbors(rare, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:50)

# Determine cluster stability
#rare <- FindClusters(rare, algorithm = 3,  resolution = seq(0.1,1, by = 0.1)) # SLM
rare <- FindClusters(rare, algorithm = 3,  resolution = 0.3) # SLM

library(clustree)
clustree::clustree(rare)
#saveRDS(rare, file="~/projects/PDAC_non_malignant_cell_types/output/cellbender/Aug24_objects/rareSamples.RDS")

Idents(rare) <- "SCT_snn_res.0.3"
rare$seurat_clusters <- NULL
rare$seurat_clusters <- rare$SCT_snn_res.0.3
DimPlot(rare, label = T) + NoLegend() + DimPlot(rare, group.by = "simspec_cell_class", label = T)
```

## Transcriptomic differences between different malignant 
```{r}
id.map <- read.csv(cfg$sample_map_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
id.map$Sample <- as.character(id.map$Sample)

# 3. Add ICGC_ID to the Seurat metadata
rare$ICGC_ID <- id.map$ICGC_ID[
  match(as.character(rare$Sample), id.map$Sample)
]

malignant.subset <- subset(rare, subset = simspec_cell_class %in% c("Malignant acinar", "PDA_OLGC","PDAC"))
malignant.subset$sample_histo <-  paste(malignant.subset$ICGC_ID, malignant.subset$simspec_cell_class, sep = "_")
Idents(malignant.subset) <- "sample_histo"
malignant.subset <- subset(malignant.subset, subset = sample_histo %in% c("ICGC_0009_PDA_OLGC", "ICGC_0075_Malignant acinar", "ICGC_0391_Malignant acinar", "ICGC_0055_PDAC", "ICGC_0061_PDAC"))
malignant.markers <- FindAllMarkers(malignant.subset, assay = "SCT", logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.2, only.pos = T)
```


## ORA 
```{r}
library("msigdbr")
library("clusterProfiler")
library("org.Hs.eg.db")
Hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
Hallmark.entrez <- dplyr::select(Hallmark, gs_name, entrez_gene)

gene.symbols <- malignant.markers$gene %>% unique() 
gene.entrez <- bitr(gene.symbols, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", drop = F)
colnames(gene.entrez)[1] <- "gene"
markers.ann <- left_join(malignant.markers, gene.entrez, by = "gene")

dgea.ls <- split(markers.ann, f=markers.ann$cluster)

#focus on up-regulated genes
dgea.up.filtered <- purrr::map(dgea.ls, ~ dplyr::filter(., avg_log2FC >= 0.25, p_val_adj < 0.001,!is.na(ENTREZID)))
dgea.ls.up.entrez.id <- purrr::map(dgea.up.filtered, ~ dplyr::pull(., ENTREZID)) #pulling a gene list

universe <- bitr(gene.symbols,
                 fromType = "SYMBOL",
                 toType = "ENTREZID",
                 OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db")
```

## Hallmark
```{r ext-data-fig-1e, fig.width=7, fig.height=7, message=FALSE}
hallmark <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = dgea.ls.up.entrez.id,
  fun = "enricher",
  minGSSize = 8,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  universe = universe$ENTREZID,
  TERM2GENE = Hallmark.entrez)
dotplot(hallmark, showCategory = 6, title="Hallmark | p_val_adj < 0.001")  + RotatedAxis() + scale_colour_gradient(low="coral3", high = "steelblue")
```
